title: Series Tags
content_html:
Series Tags

Capability

/studio/series-tags/ is the cross-series assignment review. It shows canonical coverage/status and links into the one-series editor.

The page does not directly edit table rows. Editing happens in Series Tag Editor.

Data Path

public series index
  + canonical assignments
  + registry/group config
  -> coverage/status table
  -> selected series editor link

Coverage scoring is implemented by analysis-tag-scoring.js using analysis.groups and analysis.rag projected from Studio tag policy. Assignments carry flat tag IDs. The report resolves each tag's group, label, filtering, and chip styling from the registry; it never derives group from the ID.

Code Map

  • template/controller: series-tags.html, series-tags.js
  • report/table: series-tags-render.js, analysis-tag-scoring.js

The route uses Studio ready/busy state and remains in list mode.

Weak Spots

  • Coverage status combines canonical assignment data with generated catalogue indexes; either side can be stale.
